description: Starting the Climate Conversation: Using Scenario Planning to Promote Resilience in Beef Production is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by University of Nebraska–Lincoln Institute of Agriculture and Natural Resources, Extension; South Dakota State University Extension; USDA Northern Plains Climate Hub. Beef producers shared their collective experiences with past weather, and then considered the future. This engagement strategy increased producers' value for incorporating climate into their management strategies. Coverage: the United States (2017). The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
